svg.title: RGB badge rear footprint and battery-over-board fit trial
svg.text: REAR · connector-first PicoBlade pocket, shifted control/decoder, repacked FETs
Captured coupon parts: 410; 3 driver bodies projected for final board.
Under-pack 0402 positions: 77 conditional · captured parts still unplaced: 11.
Connector pocket is illustrative; charger, VLED, input protection, RF and routing remain.
Battery needs case support above the board; height and circuit locality are unqualified.
UNALLOCATED PACKAGE MINIMA (shown to scale off-board; support parts need more space)
